manual._help: Hand edits, kept when the analysis is regenerated. boundaries: section start times (s) replacing the automatic ones (rerun npm run analyze). sections: [{ at, role, label, mood, hue }] override the section containing time `at`; role is one of hush, build, swell, climax, release, fade; hue is 0..1. cues: [{ t, type, value }] extra cue points, e.g. { "t": 281.5, "type": "burst" } or { "t": 120, "type": "hue", "value": 0.6 }.
